source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
3. Record the inspection date, time, and name of the inspector on the vehicle inspection report.
4. Note the vehicle identification number (VIN), make, model, and year of the vehicle being inspected.
5. List the components inspected within the brake system, such as the brake pads, rotors, drums, lines, fluids, calipers, and master cylinder.
6. Document any visible physical damage to the components and note any fluid leaks.
7. Describe the testing procedure, specifying whether pressure tests, dynamic tests, or bleeding were performed.
8. Detail any fault codes retrieved from the vehicle's onboard diagnostics (OBD-II) related to the brake system.
9. Report the specific performance outcomes of the brake tests, including brake pedal response, brake fluid pressure, and the functionality of ABS (Anti-lock Brake System) features, where applicable.
